title: 第七百九十八章 慈母挡关 宗门怒决第七百九十七章 慈母明心 异蝶绝情
content_zh:
叮叮当当、铮铮锵锵的金铁交鸣脆响连绵不绝、震耳欲聋。
响彻整片荒山野寺！
结界震颤不休、灵光忽明忽暗、壁垒层层损耗。
花语瑶以一己血肉神魂硬抗蝶门终极禁术，终究力不从心、难以为继！
经脉寸寸受损、气血逆行翻涌，脏腑剧痛难忍！
“噗——！”
她喉头一甜，再也压制不住翻涌的气血。
一口滚烫猩红鲜血猛然喷出，洒落半空，染红身前莹润粉光！
“师妹！！”
不远处，一直凝神观望的魔鱼长老脸色骤然大变！
瞳孔剧烈收缩，惊叫出声！
他肥胖的身躯踉跄一颤，再也稳不住身形。
扑通一声重重跪倒在满地碎石尘土之中。
往日凶悍戾气尽数散尽，只剩满脸惶恐与哀求，对着上方的花百漾连连叩首：
“宗主！求您收手！求您手下留情！
二妹她身子早已积伤，禁不起这般硬耗强撑！数十年同门情深，我们四人随你出生入死、踏血江湖、征战半生。从未有过半分忤逆！
求您顾念旧情，饶了二妹！饶了小公子吧！”
局势瞬间僵持，三方对峙。
言语交锋、情绪炸裂！
花百漾立在漫天血色爪势之中，神色冰冷漠然。

眼底没有半分松动，心性决绝如铁石。
丝毫不为同门旧情所动，攻势不减、威压不撤！
执意要惩戒虫小蝶、取回蝶刃剑法！
花语瑶浑身染血、气息浮动。
依旧死死撑住结界，哪怕神魂耗损、经脉崩碎。
也半步不退、誓死护子，眼底是宁死不屈的决绝与护犊情深的滚烫执念！
魔鱼长老跪在尘土之中，连连磕头、涕泪横流。
苦苦哀求不止，满心皆是不忍与痛心，拼命挽回仅剩的同门手足！
而蚌壳结界之内，深陷禁锢剧痛、苦苦挣扎的虫小蝶。
意识早已浮沉恍惚、如坠云雾！
浑身撕裂般的剧痛层层叠加，窒息感死死锁困神魂。
身体痛到麻木，心神摇摇欲坠！
他耳畔嗡嗡作响，外界的争执、哀求、怒斥声声入耳。
却又缥缈恍惚、不真切。
content_en:
The jingling, clanking, and clanking sounds of gold and iron are continuous and deafening.
It resounded throughout the deserted mountains and wild temples!
The barrier trembled endlessly, the aura flickered on and off, and the barriers were worn away layer by layer.
Hua Yuyao used her flesh and blood to resist the butterfly gate's ultimate forbidden technique, but in the end she was unable to survive!
The meridians are damaged, the Qi and blood surge in the reverse direction, and the internal organs are in severe pain!
"Pfft——!"
Her throat felt sweet, and she could no longer suppress the surging blood.
A mouthful of hot scarlet blood suddenly spurted out and fell into the air, dyeing the front of his body red and pink!
"Junior sister!!"
Not far away, the expression of Elder Demonic Fish, who had been watching intently, suddenly changed!
His pupils contracted violently and he screamed!
His fat body staggered and trembled, unable to maintain his balance any longer.
With a thud, he fell to his knees in the rubble and dust on the ground.
All the fierce and violent energy of the past was gone, leaving only a face full of fear and pleading, and he kowtowed to the flowers above:
"Sect Master! Please stop! Please show mercy!
The second sister's body has long been injured and she can't bear such hard work! We have been friends for decades, and the four of us have followed you through life and death, traversing the bloody rivers and lakes, and fighting for half our lives. There was never any disobedience!
Please take care of your old relationship and spare your second sister! Spare the young master! "
The situation reached a stalemate in an instant, with the three parties confronting each other.
Verbal exchanges and emotional explosions!
Hua Baiyang stood amidst the bloody claws in the sky with a cold and indifferent expression.
There is no looseness in his eyes, and his character is as determined as stone.
Not swayed at all by the old friendship between the same sect, his offensive will not diminish and his pressure will not retreat!
Determined to punish Chong Xiaodie and retrieve the butterfly blade sword technique!
Hua Yuyao's body was covered in blood and her breath was floating.
Still holding on to the barrier, even if the soul is exhausted and the meridians are broken.
He also refused to retreat even a step and vowed to protect his son to the death. In his eyes was a determination that he would rather die than surrender and a burning obsession with protecting the calf!
The elder Demon Fish knelt in the dust, kowtowed repeatedly and shed tears.
I begged and begged, my heart was full of unbearability and pain, and I tried my best to save the only remaining brothers and sisters!
Within the clam shell barrier, Chong Xiaodie was trapped in severe pain and struggling.
The consciousness has long been floating in a trance, like falling into the clouds!
Severe pain like tearing through the body was piled up layer by layer, and the feeling of suffocation locked tightly in the soul.
My body is numb from pain and my mind is shaky!
There was a buzzing in his ears, and the sounds of arguments, pleadings, and angry comments from the outside world came into his ears.
But it’s also vague and unreal.
